title: Radiation and Red Tape
logline: An optimistic mechanic tries to recover a mythical cache of old technology hidden inside a pulsar's radiation cone, but they are constantly interrupted by a corrupt inspector demanding 'safety' bribes.

roles.description: Believes the old tech will usher in a new golden age for the sector.
Only cares about golden ages if they get a 20% cut.
A heavily shielded vault spinning near a deadly pulsar.
An official safety commission ship, heavily armed 'for protection'.
A bureaucratic nightmare designed solely to extract fines.

public_situation: The {role:safety_commission} has completely cordoned off the pulsar region, citing 'extreme navigational hazards'.
private_truth: The hazards are real, but the inspector is just blocking the mechanic until they get a massive bribe to look the other way.

beats.public_change: The mechanic completes a custom radiation shield for their ship and prepares to launch.

missions.reason: The mechanic needs the pilot to fly through the radiation cone and scan the cache's lock mechanism.
missions.private_fact: The radiation will scramble the pilot's sensors temporarily.

beats.public_change: The inspector docks with the mechanic's rig and slaps an 'environmental hazard' lock on their engines.

missions.reason: The mechanic, out of options, begs the pilot to buy a wildly expensive 'safety permit' and deliver it to the inspector.
missions.private_fact: The permit is entirely fake, it's just a front for a cash bribe.

missions.reason: The inspector further demands the pilot deliver clean water ice to their ship to 'cool their sensors'.
missions.private_fact: The inspector just wants ice for their personal cocktail lounge.

beats.public_change: The lock is removed, but the inspector demands the mechanic hand over half the cache.

missions.reason: The mechanic needs the pilot to deliver a massive legal injunction to the office to force the lock off.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot holds the forged injunction. They can deliver it to open the cache, or sell it to the inspector to keep the cache sealed.

resolutions.summary: The mechanic opens the cache, revealing advanced, clean-burning engine schematics. The sector rejoices, and the safety commission is investigated for corruption.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot blew past corrupt inspectors to recover a legendary cache of old tech from a pulsar.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot sells the injunction to the inspector.
resolutions.summary: The mechanic's rig is destroyed. The inspector claims the cache for the commission, burying the technology to maintain their regulatory monopoly.
The mechanic is forced to abandon the cache. They survive, but their dreams are ruined.

loose_threads.detail: The inspector's private comms array was broadcasting the cache's coordinates to an unknown mercenary outfit.
The old tech in the cache bears the logo of the modern safety commission, as if the commission hid it there itself.

radio_hooks: {role:safety_commission} reminds pilots that pulsar diving voids all insurance.
Rumors of legendary old engine designs hidden in the deep dark.

voice_direction.corrupt_inspector: Slow, patronizing, constantly quotes fake regulations.
